zotero.abstractNote: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in long-running settings where improving through experience at test time becomes essential. We use test-time learning (TTL) to describe a deployment-time learning paradigm that complements pre-training and post-training. TTL occurs when an agent adapts its behavior during inference without costly retraining, leveraging feedback from its environment or internal state to improve performance on subsequent tasks.
